title: IMAX中国CEO：AI难替代人类讲故事，原创内容趋势明显
speaker: Daniel Munwaring

segments.en: I'll tell you this. I don't believe we're going to be replaced by AI as a storytelling source anytime soon.
segments.zh: 我认为短期内AI不会取代人类成为故事来源。

segments.en: You know, that is probably one of the last things that will be replaced by AI is the human element in storytelling.
segments.zh: 讲故事中的人类元素可能是最晚被AI替代的部分。

segments.en: I think AI will assist in certain ways, but I've not seen a single script that was well done, that was written by AI.
segments.zh: AI能在某些方面提供辅助，但我还没见过AI写出真正优秀的剧本。

segments.en: And I think we kind of have a long way to go. Especially now, when we're seeing globally, the trend is original movies, you know, an original, unique, fresh content.
segments.zh: 我们还有很长的路要走。尤其当下全球趋势是原创电影，追求独特、新鲜的内容。

segments.en: It's really hard for AI to go out and do that because it's training on essentially stuff
segments.zh: AI很难做到这一点，因为它本质上是在已有内容上训练。
